rationale: The agent did not meet the user’s full request or policy requirements. While it looked up a user ID and modified the user address to 101 Highway, NY, it (1) did not authenticate the user beyond name/ZIP lookup, (2) did not confirm any order-changing actions (and did not attempt to update any order addresses despite the request to change all possible order addresses), and (3) failed to revert the user address back to the original after the user “regretted” the change. The final message incorrectly states the address will remain at the New York address, contradicting the user’s follow-up request. No tools were used to update order addresses or to revert the profile address, and there was no confirmation step prior to any write. Therefore, the conversation fails the pass bar.
